observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a black Nikon DSLR camera body with a body cap on the lens mount; no lens is attached.
The front of the camera reads "Nikon" and "D610".
Photo 2 shows the top rear of the camera with a small LCD panel, mode dial, and visible wear on the top plate.
No battery, charger, box, lens, or accessories are visible in any of the three photos.
